jeffersonia.definition:
n. An American herb with a pretty, white, solitary
   blossom, and deeply two-cleft leaves (Jeffersonia diphylla); twinleaf.

jeffersonian.definition:
n. a follower of Thomas Jefferson or his ideas and principles
a. relating to or characteristic of Thomas Jefferson or his principles or theories
jeffersonian.translation:

jeffersonite.definition:
n. A variety of pyroxene of olive-green color passing
   into brown. It contains zinc.
